title: Jared Birchall, a Mormon elder, as Elon Musk's handler

tellings.quote: connection is Elon's like basically like sort of handler like his like the man who manages all of his affairs.

plain: A commentator named Matthew Pines says that Jared Birchall, described as a Mormon church elder, is basically the "handler" of the billionaire Elon Musk, the man who manages all of his affairs. Pines raises it as a connection worth noticing, since it would mean someone with ties of his own sits close to one of the world's most powerful businessmen.
